messages:
harper_ops: quick follow-up from today’s all-hands infra segment. thanks for running through the capacity roadmap! :clap:
harper_ops: a couple of concrete asks: 1) will we allow customers to "reserve inventory" across regions (e.g., reserve NA but backfill EU when available)? 2) how does preemptible burst billing work if we move traffic between regions?

leah_infra: short answers: 1) yes, reservation intent will be supported in the console. Customers can select a preferred region and optionally enable cross-region backfill. The reservation shows an "estimated fulfillment date" based on confirmed shipments.

leah_infra: 2) burst billing is metered where the work executes. If we route to a different region for burst, the cost is billed to the customer's account as burst usage in that region. We'll surface cross-region cost estimates in the reservation flow.

ryan_sre: extra detail on latency / tail risk: warm pools are per-region to minimize cross-region RTT. Cross-region backfill only used when local capacity exhausted and customer enabled it. Fallback model routing (smaller/quantized variants) is preferred over cross-region routing for latency-sensitive SLAs.

sam_product: suggestion: show a small checkbox in signup: "Allow cross-region backfill if local capacity is unavailable" with tooltip explaining latency implications. Ops please add to signup copy backlog.

infra-bot: [deploy] inventory-sync v1 scheduled: 2026-09-03T04:00Z -> run: reconcile shipments -> update region ETA. Monitor: inventory_sync_failures, region_eta_diff.

ryan_sre: config snippet for teams testing reservation/backfill behavior locally:```yaml
reservation_policy:
  preferred_region: us-east-1
  allow_cross_region_backfill: true
  backfill_priority: local_first
  preemptible_burst_ratio: 0.25
```

harper_ops: thanks, that helps. couple more operational Qs: will we publish a rolling inventory dashboard for sales/AE teams? and do reserved commits get priority to warm pools?

leah_infra: yes to both: internal inventory dashboard for sales will be available (read-only) and reservation commits get higher priority in allocation and warm pool reservation for the chosen region. That priority persists until the commit window starts or the customer cancels.

maya_ceo: good. product & infra to produce a single one-pager and an internal FAQ for sales by EOD Thursday so AEs don't overpromise. Also include the signup checkbox copy.

sam_product: will coordinate with infra. I9ll draft the checkbox wording and the one-pager and post back here for review.

ryan_sre: final note: during the autoscaler canary we9ll enable a smoke test that simulates 3x baseline spikes and ensure cold_start_rate < 5% for 15m. If violated, rollback.

infra-bot: [alert] canary-plan created: autoscaler-canary -> smoke-test: 3x spike -> rollback if cold_start_rate > 5% for 15m.

harper_ops: perfect. ping me when the one-pager is posted and I9ll sync with Sales Ops. :thumbsup:
